Griffiss Institute has powered American innovation to secure the nation from its home and headquarters in the Mohawk Valley region of New York State since 2002.

Page Directory Our Mission Our Story Our Values Board of Directors Vision American Innovation to Secure the Nation Mission Griffiss Institute empowers the next generation of STEM talent, disruptive technologies, and mission-driven startups to strengthen U.S. national security and expand economic opportunity for our region, state, and nation.
A PIA is an agreement, (contract or memorandum of understanding), between the government and an intermediary organization, (state or local governmental agency or nonprofit entity).

As a Partnership Intermediary the GI performs services for the AFRL/RF that increase the likelihood of success in the conduct of cooperative or joint activities with small business firms, institutions of higher education, and industry.

Return to Page Directory Our Story As we reflect on our journey, one thing remains constant – our unwavering commitment to fostering innovation, collaboration, and excellence in the ever-evolving landscape of defense technology for our nation’s security, and economic development.
PARTNERSHIP We thrive on collaboration with government, industry, academia, and community.

Return to Page Directory Strategic Rationale One Nation, Secure in Science A resilient scientific community and healthy innovation infrastructure are essential not only for national security but also for economic competitiveness and societal progress.

We believe that preparing more American scientists, engineeers, and entrepreneurs to work collaboratively across organizations will strengthen our nation’s ability to solve complex challenges in areas such as cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, advanced materials, and emerging technologies.

At Griffiss Institute, we exist to strengthen America’s competitive advantage by elevating people, empowering discovery, and accelerating solutions that secure the systems critical to our national security and economy.
By supporting dual-use startups, we strengthen the defense industrial base and enable mission-aligned founders.
Richard Joseph Chief Scientist (Ret.) United States Air Force Jeffrey Dunbar University at Buffalo (Ret.) Secretary to the Board of the Empire Discovery Institute Kevin Martin, Esq.
